description: lq-maintainer-agent §2.1 safety floor — PreToolUse hook registration for the plugin path. Auto-discovered at the plugin root (hooks/hooks.json); the hook body lives at settings/hooks/block-writes.sh and, per v0.6, enforces an ALLOW-LIST of read-only gh subcommands (gh api non-GET denied by default) plus the git push / PR-ref-checkout / alias-laundering blocks. Two floors (v0.8.0, rules/runtime.md RT-09): a session that ran the lq-maintainer-safety-canary is ARMED and gets that full review floor; a session that never ran it gets the coder floor, which still blocks merge, review, close, delete, GraphQL, aliases and every PR-ref fetch/checkout but lets git push and ordinary gh writes reach the host's own permission prompt. Codex trusts this hook by a hash of its definition, so any change to this file re-arms Codex's /hooks trust review. This file carries ONLY the hooks block (no permissions key — plugins cannot inject permission rules); keep it in sync with the hooks block in settings/claude-settings.json, the reference copy lq-ai vendors into its own .claude/ for non-plugin sessions (M0). Known limits of hook enforcement are documented in settings/README.md and design §10.1 — in particular, no hook runs under --dangerously-skip-permissions, which onboarding forbids for triage sessions. Changes here are §3.6 permission-bearing: two maintainer reviews, CODEOWNERS-routed.
